create.name: Dr. Lise Janelle
create.bio:
Lise Janelle is a Toronto coach whose work centres on what she calls living from the heart. She began in 1989 as a holistic chiropractor, spending some two decades in hands-on mind-body practice with patients one at a time, and moved into coaching in 2004. From that long stretch of individual sessions she put together the Heart Freedom Method, a short guided process meant to bring hidden beliefs and protective habits to the surface so that a person can act from clarity rather than fear. She has belonged to the Transformational Leadership Council for more than twenty years.

Today she runs the Centre for Heart Living from an office in Toronto and works with clients both there and online. Much of her teaching is about love and intimacy: why people repeat the same patterns with partners, and how self-worth shapes the relationships they choose. She offers private and high-performance coaching, a weekend intensive, a silent retreat, a relationships programme and a six-month certification for coaches who want to use her method. Her book Conversation with the Heart, also published in Spanish, invites readers to listen inwardly for direction, and her YouTube channel carries short talks on relationships alongside her podcast with Dana Giroux.

books.title: Conversation with the Heart
books.author: Dr. Lise Janelle
books.description: A guide to turning attention inward and treating the heart as a source of direction. It walks readers through recognising where a sense of emptiness comes from, clarifying purpose, and making choices that fit their own values.

courses.title: The Breakthrough Intensive
courses.description: A two-day weekend workshop in downtown Toronto, with an online option for those who join with a partner. Participants learn the Heart Freedom Method and practise it on one area of life where they feel held back.

courses.title: Heart Freedom Method Certification
courses.description: A six-month training for coaches and practitioners who want to use her method with their own clients. It combines group workshops with individual sessions and supervised practice.

courses.title: Private One-to-One Coaching
courses.description: Individual coaching in Toronto or online, starting with a free exploratory call. Sessions focus on getting clear about what matters most and loosening the beliefs that stop someone acting on it.

courses.title: Elite One-to-One Coaching
courses.description: A closer coaching package for executives, athletes and others working under high pressure. The aim is decision-making that comes from a settled inner place rather than old fears.

courses.title: Soul Worthy Love
courses.description: A programme on intimacy and partnership that contrasts infatuation with lasting love. It pairs teaching on how relationships work with her method for clearing beliefs that get in the way of closeness.

courses.title: Love Is Safe Starter Kit
courses.description: A short digital starter pack about why people are drawn to partners who cannot meet them. It takes about twenty minutes and suggests first steps towards choosing differently.

courses.title: 3 Days of Silence & Wisdom
courses.description: A silent residential retreat in a natural setting, with optional morning yoga or walks, guided meditations and journalling from a workbook. Shared meals and free time leave room for rest and reflection.

courses.title: The Art of True Love Workshop
courses.description: A one-day relationships workshop held at her Toronto centre and online. It looks at the expectations people bring to partnership and how to build more connection; the next dates are still to be announced.

free_resources.title: Heart Freedom Meditation
free_resources.description: A five-minute guided meditation for the start of the day, designed to help the listener settle attention in the heart. It is sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Happy Relationship Checklist
free_resources.description: A free e-book on telling infatuation apart from real love, with pointers for people in new and long-standing relationships.

free_resources.title: Best Friend Journal
free_resources.description: A free journalling guide for building a kinder inner voice and responding to everyday challenges with more steadiness.
